idea: Relax every edge again and again: a shorter way to a node may exist through a neighbour. After V - 1 rounds all shortest distances are final. One more round that still improves something proves a negative cycle.
useWhen: You must detect negative cycles, for example in currency exchange
avoidWhen: All weights are positive and speed matters (Dijkstra is faster)
The graph is huge: V * E grows quickly
